background_removal.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied 48x48 pixel game item icon, Hasla Courage Token. Remove ONLY its dark gray/purple square background and the background drop shadow. Output one PNG with real transparent alpha behind the complete token. Preserve the existing token's exact silhouette, original small pixel details, beige/brown color, brightness, framing, position, size and orientation. Do not redraw, reinterpret, smooth, sharpen, add detail, add text, add borders, or invent anything. Keep the full original 48x48 canvas and object placement; return at 48x48 pixels if possible. The jagged brown and beige token is the foreground; the square background is removed completely. No checkerboard baked into the image.
